title: Documentary explores whether JMW Turner may have been neurodivergent
summary: Programme uses artist’s sketches, drawings and watercolours to build unprecedented psychological portrait He is widely regarded as England’s greatest painter, but despite his extraordinary output, elements of JMW Turner’s personality have remained a mystery. Now, a groundbreaking BBC documentary delves into Turner’s 37,000 sketches, drawings and watercolours to build an unprecedented psychological portrait, one that raises the possibility that Turner’s singular vision was shaped by childhood trauma and neurodivergence.
